source: bytes = config + all layers of https://registry.ollama.ai/v2/library/<name>/manifests/<tag>; model layers checked for GGUF magic

fields.bytes: Exact download size in bytes (sum of config and all layers, incl. vision projector). The builder re-measures and refuses mismatches above 1 %.
fields.tier: 1-2 small (may run on CPU), 3 mid GPU, 4 large GPU. Select-PnhModel uses only tier <= 2 without a usable GPU. Ranking (largest first) = minVramGB, then tier, then bytes.
fields.minVramGB: GiB the model needs on the GPU at 'ctx' (weights incl. projector, KV cache q8_0, buffers). Chosen when best dedicated NVIDIA/AMD VRAM - 1.5 GiB >= minVramGB.
fields.gpuMinRamGB: Optional. Models that are meant to run partially offloaded also need this much system RAM on the GPU path.
fields.partialOffload: Optional. true = running partly on the CPU is intended (do not require 100 % GPU in Test-PnhModelFit).
fields.minRamGB: GiB the model needs on the CPU path (weights, KV cache at 16k, buffers, about 1 GiB margin). Chosen when RAM - 4 GiB >= minRamGB.
fields.ctx: num_ctx: 16384 for tiers 1-2 (CPU speed, enough for 12 short rounds), 32768 for tiers 3-4 (GPU, minVramGB includes it). Capped at 16384 when a model runs on the CPU.
fields.think: Default for the Ollama 'think' flag. Off for tiers 1-3 (Qwen3.5 renders a clean non-thinking mode; thinking costs minutes on CPU), on for tier 4 (GPU). Not yet A/B tested.
fields.freeShell: Model may propose free PowerShell commands (filtered, confirmed).
fields.gguf: Model layer has media type application/vnd.ollama.image.model and starts with the GGUF magic (no MLX/safetensors tag).

small.description: Tiers 1-2 only, for small drives and CPU-only PCs.

standard.description: Default: one model per class from CPU to 24 GB GPUs.

full.description: Everything, incl. the Q8 9B and the MoE fast mode.

models.notes: Smallest Apache-2.0 tier, replaces lfm3:1.7b (LFM licence). Tool use weak (H: BFCL-V4 43.6): diagnose and ask before every change. Thinking off: the model card warns about thinking loops at 2B, and thinking costs minutes on CPU.

Best evidence of all small models (Qwen, Liquid and NVIDIA agree; NVIDIA Q4_K_M Tau2 61.7). CPU default for PCs with 10 GiB+ RAM, GPU from 6 GB cards. Thinking off for CPU speed (about 8 tok/s on a 16-core CPU).

GPU tier for 10-12 GB cards (H: BFCL-V4 66.1, TAU2 79.1). Same parser and prompts as the tiers around it. Not used on CPU (tier rule). Thinking off: on a mid-range GPU a thinking round adds 10-30 s; A/B test pending.
Optional: same model without Q4 loss for 16 GB cards when the MoE tier is not installed or RAM is below 32 GiB.

Strongest local agent model (H: Terminal-Bench 2.1 73.0). 24 GB+ cards (measured by others: 20 GB at 32k). Thinking on: GPU-only tier, multi-step reliability matters more than latency; qwen3.8 defaults to reasoning effort xhigh and may think long - mapping of Ollama 'think' to the effort is unverified.

Optional fast mode: MoE with 3B active parameters (183 tok/s on an RTX 5090 per blog). Runs on 16 GB cards with partial offload when the PC has 32 GB RAM (gpuMinRamGB 30: a 32 GB PC reports about 31.8 GiB). Built-in MTP heads (params draft_num_predict 2), but the model layer is a normal GGUF blob, so it stays in the catalogue.
